title: SG Surface
html:
SG_Surface is a status group.

List of conditions in SG_Surface

Condition Effects
Acid
  • Reduces  Armour Class by 2.
Assassin's Blood
  • Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw or take 1d12⁠⁠Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest.
  • On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Auntie Ethel's Special Brew
  • The affected creature takes 2d6⁠⁠Poison at the start of every turn until passing a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks
  • Affected entity takes 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet.
  • Immune from if Wet.
  •  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
Burning Acid
  • The hatchery waters burn through all those who'd intrude upon it.
Burning Fiercely
  • Takes 1d10⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Caustic Brine
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Acid damage per turn.
Chilled
  • Affected entity is vulnerable to ⁠Cold damage and resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Applying  Wet to a chilled entity will make it Frozen for Duration: 1 turn.
Cloudkill
  • While it remains in the cloud, affected entity takes 5d8⁠⁠Poison damage every turn.
Constricted
  • Affected entity can't move.  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its attack rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
  • The entity takes 2d6+2⁠⁠Piercing and 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn.
  • Can be removed by  Help.
Difficult Terrain
  • Movement Speed halved
Difficult Terrain: Deep Water
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Lava
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Mud
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Vines
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Web
  • Movement speed halved.
Drenched
  • Your melee attacks inflict  Wet on the target.
Electrocuted
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Lightning damage at the start of each turn.
Entangled
  • Cannot move.
  •  Attack Rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Enwebbed
  • Cannot move.
  •  Attack Rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws are rolled with  Disadvantage.
Green Bed Regeneration
  • When starting your turn on  Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.
Haste Spores
  • Affected entity has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
Holy Fire
  • Takes 1~4⁠⁠Radiant damage per turn.
Icy Cloud
  • A sheet of frigid air dealing 10d6⁠⁠Cold to all that walk through it.
  • Affected entities can make a  DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw to take half damage instead.
Infernal Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
  • The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points
Melting
  • Takes 10d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Noxious Fumes
  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison each turn. It must succeed a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional 2d4⁠⁠Poison, taking half damage in a success.
Oily Sup
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Plant Growth
  • The ground is covered with plants and weeds. Movement Speed is quartered.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Inflicts 3d6⁠⁠Poison every turn until a successful  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Poisoned
  • Deals 3d6⁠⁠Poison per turn
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • At the beginning of the turn, makes a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw to end the condition on success.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Ends on a successful  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of the turn.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Poisonous Fumes
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage per turn.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Regeneration
  • The Wood Woad regains 10⁠⁠Hit Points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.
Roiling Hellfire
  • Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Scorching Aura
  • Attacks dealt by this entity deal a bonus 1d6⁠⁠Fire unless it is made  Wet.
Selune's Blessing: Moonsnare
  • Movement speed halved.
Shadow-Cursed Vines
  • Affected entity can't move and takes 1d4⁠⁠NecroticDRS damage per turn. Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Sickly
  • Feeling extremely off - suspiciously so.
Spike Growth
  • Take 2d4⁠⁠Piercing for every 1.5 m (5 ft) moved on the spikes.
Stench of Death
  • Affected entity reeks of decaying matter, a sour greenish smell like a waft of unkept tombs.
Sword Spider's Haste
  • Affected entity has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed is doubled, and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
Weavebound Vines
  • Vines crafted from the very Weave itself - a most unorthodox enchantment.
  • Incapacitates the affected entity. Dispelled when the entity is attacked.
Wet
  • Immune to  Burning and  Wild Magic: Burning.
  • Resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Vulnerable to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Cold damage.
